'''''Berea-3''''' was a "combination [[Starship/Legends|ship]]" that consisted of a stripped-down [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] that had been coupled to a [[Mining rig (suit)|mining rig]]. The vessel was used by the company [[Imperial Mining, Ltd.]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Berea-3'' acted as the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of an IML [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was dispatched to deliver supplies to an IML base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]], in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. However, shortly after arriving in the [[Alluuvian system]], the ''Berea-3'' and the rest of the fleet were attacked and defeated by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ship and the [[Shepherd-class shuttle|''Shepherd''-class]] [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] ''[[Varnay]]''.
